items.titleZh: 奥康否认与哈斯分歧中使用暴力
items.summaryZh: 奥康称在墨西哥大奖赛周末中途被哈斯替换前，车队内部存在“观点分歧”，但否认了“使用了肢体暴力”的猜测。哈斯未说明换人原因，后备车手平川亮因此完成F1排位赛和正赛首秀。

media.altZh: 奥康否认与哈斯分歧中使用暴力 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Ocon denies using violence in his disagreement with Haas
items.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon said there was a "difference in viewpoints" within Haas before his shock replacement mid-way through the Mexican Grand Prix weekend, but rejected speculation that "physical violence was used". Haas did not give a reason for the change, and reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa went on to make his F1 qualifying and race debut.
detailZh: 埃斯特班·奥康称，在F1墨西哥大奖赛周末中途被意外替换之前，哈斯内部存在“观点分歧”，但他否认了“使用了肢体暴力”的猜测。
奥康在墨西哥被哈斯后备车手平川亮替换，这位日本车手此前已在第一节练习中作为其测试与后备车手计划的一部分替车队出场。
周六上午，哈斯出人意料地宣布，已在第二节练习中回到赛车的奥康不会完成本周末剩余比赛，平川亮将改为完成自己的F1排位赛和正赛首秀。
哈斯没有给出原因，但很快可以明确的是，这与疾病或伤病无关——而这两者通常是周末中途换人的原因。
在官方解释缺位留下的空白中，一些猜测提到了周五晚上的争执。法国《队报》甚至报道称“车队领队小松礼雄与奥康的会面突然结束，甚至可能发生了肢体冲突”。
在第二次自由练习中，奥康因对一项他并不满意的运行计划调整与比赛工程师劳拉·穆勒进行了充满沮丧的车队无线电通话，随后他戴着赛车头盔回到车库，明显显得沮丧，但此后没有证据表明发生了任何不当之事。
奥康在周末中途离队发生时以及周六大部分时间里都保持沉默，但在排位赛之后，他发表了一份声明，这份声明更侧重于纠正他所了解到的一种事件版本，而非说明自己的处境。
“在哈斯F1车队最近做出决定、确认我将不参加本周末的墨西哥城大奖赛之后，我希望正式回应一些围绕此事的媒体报道和猜测，”奥康说。
昨晚，观点上的分歧引发了与相关各方的一次讨论。
虽然我承认此事确实发生，但我坚决否认任何暗示曾使用任何形式的身体暴力来解决任何性质分歧的报道或指控。
我强烈谴责一切形式的暴力，并坚信分歧应始终以专业、尊重和相互理解的方式处理。
我恳请大家在此事处理期间避免猜测。
“后续进展将在适当时候通报。”
奥康承认存在“观点分歧”，随后又提到“任何性质的分歧”，这虽然含糊，但至少支持了这样一种解读：让奥康坐冷板凳是哈斯车队在练习赛之后发生的某件事后做出的有意选择。
不过，那件事究竟是什么仍不清楚，因为哈斯车队拒绝进一步讨论此事，而车队领队小松礼雄在第三次自由练习赛期间于维修区墙接受天空体育F1采访时也多次拒绝置评。
平川亮顶替奥康，在F1首秀中排位赛位列第19快。
detailEn: Esteban Ocon has claimed there was a "difference in viewpoints" within Haas prior to his shock replacement in the middle of Formula 1's Mexican Grand Prix weekend - but has rejected speculation "physical violence was used".
Ocon has been replaced by Haas reserve Ryo Hirakawa in Mexico, where the Japanese driver had filled in already during FP1 as part of his test and reserve programme.

On Saturday morning, Haas made the surprise announcement that Ocon - who had been back in the car for FP2 - would not complete the rest of the weekend and Hirakawa would make his F1 qualifying and race debut instead.
Haas did not give a reason why but it soon became clear it was not related to illness or injury - the factors typically responsible for a mid-weekend change like this.

In the vacuum left by an official explanation, some speculation alluded to an altercation on Friday evening. French newspaper L'Equipe even reported "the meeting between team principal Ayao Komatsu and Ocon ended abruptly, perhaps even physically".

After a frustrated radio communication with his race engineer Laura Mueller in FP2, over a runplan change Ocon was not happy with, he returned to his garage with his crash helmet still on and seemed demonstrably frustrated, but there was no evidence of anything untoward taking place thereafter.

Ocon remained silent on his mid-weekend exit when it happened and for most of Saturday but after qualifying he issued a statement that was more focused on correcting a version of events he had become aware of, than it was addressing his situation.

"Following the recent decision from Haas F1 Team confirming that I will not be participating in this weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix, I wish to formally address some media reports and speculation surrounding the situation," said Ocon.
"Last night, a difference in viewpoints led to a discussion with the parties involved.
"Whilst I acknowledge that this took place, I categorically reject any reports or allegations suggesting that any form of physical violence was used to resolve any differences of any nature.
"I strongly condemn violence in all its forms and firmly believe that disagreements should always be handled with professionalism, respect, and mutual understanding.
"I kindly ask that speculation be avoided while the matter is being addressed.
"Further updates will be communicated in due course."

That Ocon acknowledges a "difference in viewpoints" and then "differences of any nature" is vague but at least supports the interpretation that benching him was a deliberate choice made by Haas in response to something that happened after practice.

Exactly what that was remains unclear, though, given Haas refuses to discuss the matter further and team boss Ayao Komatsu repeatedly declined to comment when interviewed by Sky Sports F1 while on the pitwall during FP3.
Hirakawa qualified 19th fastest on his F1 debut in Ocon's place.
keyPointsZh: 平川亮此前已在第一节练习中替哈斯出场，这是其测试与后备车手计划的一部分。
哈斯在周六上午宣布换人，奥康在第二节练习中已回到赛车，换人原因与疾病或伤病无关。
keyPointsEn: Hirakawa had already filled in during FP1 as part of his test and reserve programme.
Haas made the announcement on Saturday morning; Ocon had been back in the car for FP2, and the change was not related to illness or injury.

items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton "lost for words" after ending three-year F1 pole drought at Mexican GP
items.summaryEn: Seven-time Formula 1 world champion Lewis Hamilton took his first grand prix pole position for Ferrari at the Mexican Grand Prix, beating former Mercedes team-mate George Russell by just 0.009 seconds to end a three-year wait for a pole.
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在墨西哥大奖赛终结三年F1杆位荒后表示“无言以对”。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿在墨西哥大奖赛为法拉利拿下个人首个大奖赛杆位后表示“无言以对”。
致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更广范围的最新法拉利F1新闻、车手动态、技术分析与比赛反应。
七届F1世界冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿在墨西哥大奖赛为法拉利拿下个人首个大奖赛杆位后，承认自己“无言以对”。
这位英国车手以仅0.009秒的优势击败了前梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔，结束了长达三年的大奖赛杆位等待。这是汉密尔顿职业生涯的第105个杆位，扩大了他自己保持的F1纪录，也是他自2023年匈牙利大奖赛以来的首个杆位。
在排位赛后接受2009年世界冠军简森·巴顿采访时，汉密尔顿解释道：“感觉太棒了！感觉真好！我太高兴了。我激动得说不出话来。这个周末真的非常艰难。”
“第一节练习中，我们使用了空气动力学尾翼，昨天又遇到了引擎问题，这意味着我们处于被动，我没能完成长距离测试。但我们在赛车调校方面做得非常好。我们从上一场比赛中学习到了很多。”
“我们所有人之间的差距非常小。比如在第二节排位赛中，我一开始没能完成飞驰圈。我认为其他人在起步时用了新轮胎，但能在这里拿到杆位，在墨西哥拿到第105个杆位，感觉非常特别，我喜欢这个数字。”
41岁的汉密尔顿成为自1982年马里奥·安德雷蒂以来，F1中最年长的杆位获得者。
当被问及41岁如何还能做到时，汉密尔顿说：“有志者，事竟成！对我们所有人来说，一切都在于心态。你可能会感到酸痛，幸运的是我没有。”
“我经常打拳，做各种不同的事情来努力保持年轻和健康，但我热爱我所做的事。”
“那份热爱并未消失。我每天醒来都在想它，做梦也梦到它。我在全世界都得到了惊人的支持。”
“这些人一直激励着我前进，所以我希望他们今天对此感到满意，也希望我明天能为他们交出好成绩。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton "lost for words" after ending three-year F1 pole drought at Mexican GP
Lewis Hamilton was left "lost for words" after securing his first grand prix pole position for Ferrari at the Mexican Grand Prix
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Seven-time Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton admitted he was "lost for words" after claiming his first grand prix pole position for Ferrari at the Mexican Grand Prix.

The Briton beat his former Mercedes team-mate George Russell by just 0.009 seconds to end a three-year wait for a grand prix pole position. It is the 105th pole of Hamilton's career, extending his own F1 record, and his first since the 2023 Hungarian Grand Prix.
While speaking to 2009 champion Jenson Button after qualifying, Hamilton explained: "That felt great! That feels good! I'm so happy. I'm lost for words. It's been a really challenging weekend.

"FP1, we had an [aero] rake running and an engine issue yesterday, which meant we were on the back foot and I didn't get to do a long run. But we've done a really good job with the set-up. We learned a lot from the last race.

"It's so close between us all. For example, in Q2, I didn't get my lap in at the beginning. I think the others have a new tyre for the start but to have pole here. It feels special to be here in Mexico and 105, I like that number."
At 41 years old, Hamilton became the oldest driver to claim a pole position in F1 since Mario Andretti in 1982.
"When there's a will, there's a way! It's all in the mind for all of us. You might feel aches and pains, luckily I don't," Hamilton said when asked how he is still doing it at 41.
"I spar a lot and do all those different things you do to try to keep yourself young and fit but I love what I do.
"That love is not gone. I wake up every day thinking about it, I dream about it. I've got this amazing support around the world.
"These guys keep me going, so I hope they're happy with that today and I hope I can deliver for them tomorrow."
keyPointsZh: 这是汉密尔顿职业生涯第105个杆位，继续刷新由他自己保持的F1纪录。
keyPointsEn: It is the 105th pole of Hamilton's career, extending his own F1 record.

items.originalTitle: Lewis Hamilton buoyed by historic first Ferrari F1 pole: "I still love what I do"
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿凭借历史性的首次法拉利F1杆位感到振奋："我依然热爱我所做的事情"
刘易斯·汉密尔顿通过在墨西哥城大奖赛中获得首个法拉利杆位，成为F1历史上第五位最年长的杆位得主
在庆祝他七个世界冠军的地方，刘易斯·汉密尔顿为他辉煌的F1生涯和深厚的墨西哥记忆库增添了又一章，这是他久违的荣誉
汉密尔顿打破了法拉利的杆位荒，为车队赢得了2026年的首个杆位，在此过程中，他也获得了自己的首个红色杆位，这是自2023年匈牙利大奖赛以来的首个杆位。在此过程中，他成为了41岁297天的第五位最年长的杆位得主，现在在所有时间榜上位于马里奥·安德雷蒂和尼尔·曼塞尔之间
在梅赛德斯车队的乔治·拉塞尔在阿特鲁迪奥·赫尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道上，凭借最后一圈的冲刺从查尔斯·勒克莱尔手中夺走了杆位之后，汉密尔顿以微弱的优势在第一圈中取得领先，从而从他的前队友手中夺走了杆位，差距仅为0.009秒。
“哦，我简直不知道该说什么了。在墨西哥感到非常特别，这是我第一次驾驶法拉利获得杆位，而且还是第105次。我喜欢这个数字，”汉密尔顿说。
汉密尔顿在周五的练习中因为动力单元问题损失了宝贵的赛道时间，FP2中仅完成了13圈。但尽管如此，这位英国人在对法拉利在高原、低抓地力表面的表现感到非常满意，仅在夜间进行了最小的调整。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
“这真是一个非常艰难、充满挑战的周末，”他说。
“显然，在FP1中，我们遇到了[空气动力学]倾斜问题，然后我们昨天又遇到了发动机问题，这意味着我们处于劣势。我没有进行长时间的比赛，但我们在本周末对赛车设置做了很好的工作。”
当被告知他是自安德雷蒂以来F1最年长的杆位车手时，这引起了关于他长寿的评论，汉密尔顿回应道：“哦，伙计，有志者事竟成。这都在于心态。我做了所有能做的事情来保持自己年轻和健康。”
“但我热爱我所做的事情，这种热爱并未消失。我每天醒来都会想这件事。我梦到它，而且我得到了世界各地这些人的惊人支持，他们让我继续前进，所以我希望他们今天会为此感到高兴，我希望我明天能为他们带来回报。”
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton buoyed by historic first Ferrari F1 pole: "I still love what I do"
Lewis Hamilton became Formula 1's fifth-oldest polesitter by taking his maiden Ferrari pole the Mexico City Grand Prix

On the site of two of his seven world championship celebrations, Lewis Hamilton added yet another chapter to his illustrious Formula 1 career and his fond Mexico memory bank, one that was long overdue.

Hamilton broke Ferrari's pole drought by earning the Scuderia its first pole of 2026, and in the process also secured his first one in red, his first pole since the 2023 Hungarian Grand Prix. In the process he became the fifth-oldest polesitter to do so at 41 years and 297 days, now perched in between Mario Andretti and Nigel Mansell on the all-time list.

After Mercedes' George Russell had taken provisional pole away from Charles Leclerc with his final run at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, Hamilton responded with a marginally faster first sector to take pole away from his former team-mate by a minuscule 0.009s.
"Oh man, I'm lost for words. It feels special to be in Mexico and get my first pole with Ferrari, and number 105. I like that number," Hamilton said.

Hamilton's pole came after losing valuable track time in Friday practice with a power unit issue, limiting him to 13 laps in FP2. But despite that hiccup the Briton had actually been delighted with how his Ferrari behaved itself on the high-altitude, low-grip surface, with only minimal setup changes made overnight.
Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari, George Russell, Mercedes
"It's been a really, really tough, challenging weekend," he said.

"Obviously, in FP1. We had a [aerodynamic] rake running, and we obviously then had the engine issue we had yesterday, which meant that we were just on the back foot. I didn't get to do a long run, but we've done a really good job with the setup over the weekend."

When told he was F1's oldest polesitter since Andretti, which prompted comments on his longevity, Hamilton responded: "Oh man, when there's a will, there's a way. It's all in the mind. I do all those different things that you can do to try and keep yourself young and fit.

"But I love what I do, and that love is not gone. I wake up every day thinking about it. I dream about it, and I've got this amazing support around the world that these guys keep me going, so I hope they're happy with that today, and I hope that I can deliver for them tomorrow."
